sql: SELECT event_ticker e, count(*) n, round(avg(period_reward_usd),0) avg_pool, round(sum(period_reward_usd),0) tot_pool, round(avg(target_size),0) tgt, min(start_date)::date st, min(end_date)::text pend, min(close_time)::date cl, max(market_title) ex FROM incentive_programs WHERE end_date > now() - interval '40 days' AND series_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPSAY%' GROUP BY event_ticker ORDER BY st DESC LIMIT 25
